hero.statement: A **workbench**, not a portfolio — small tools I build because I need them, shipped in the open as they're ready.
hero.sub: Currently: two Chrome extensions live. More entries — apps, games, services — get added to the log below as they ship. No polish theater, no roadmap slides. Just what's actually working.

about.label: About
about.body: Curious by nature, I enjoy exploring software development, cybersecurity, AI, and browser technologies. I build things that solve real problems for myself first, then refine them into tools others might find useful. This site is a living record of that process—shipping, learning, and improving one project at a time.

ui.colophon: Set in Big Shoulders Display & IBM Plex Mono. Built by hand, no framework.

products.title: Lyric Sync
products.desc: My first extension to ship. A floating, draggable lyrics panel for Japanese songs on YouTube — furigana readings, karaoke-style word highlighting with adjustable lead time, and synced Traditional Chinese translation. Built with **kuromoji** tokenization and a custom overrides file for the readings it gets wrong.

products.title: Taiwan 100 Peaks Map
products.desc: Overlays Taiwan's **百岳 (100 Peaks)** onto Google Maps directly from the URL's coordinates — no API billing required. Each peak gets an elevation-aware pin and a direct link to the unified permit portal, so planning a route doesn't mean fifteen open tabs.
